name: Matched-rate random-hold baseline (methodology review 2026-10-22, item 3): does the trigger know WHEN, or does any pause help?
written: 2026-10-22 ~09:30, before any episode of this test

arms.cbfh: Stage 4 hold-and-replan exactly (model_OIL trigger, hold one chunk, gripper untouched)
arms.cbfrh: same hold, at RANDOM decisions with p = 1463/14973 = 9.77% (cbfh's realised Stage 4 rate); per-episode trigger seed

settings: Stage 4 settings (eval/stage4_local.sh): stress layouts, settled start, execution noise x2 (old noise model, for comparability with Stage 4), HARD_OFF=1, per-episode seeds, 60 chunks; run locally, all arms on the same machine.
outcome: neighbour topples (primary), v4 and v4b success via eval/outcome_audit.py
primary: cbfh has fewer neighbour topples than cbfrh: paired one-sided exact McNemar, alpha 0.05. If it fails, the Jenga benefit cannot be attributed to the trigger's timing.
secondary: cbfrh vs record (topples, McNemar one-sided); v4 / v4b differences cbfh - cbfrh with paired bootstrap 95% CIs; realised intervention rates per arm.
